# Intent-graph harness — BASELINE, before R1 (7874dde)

Frozen. Captured from a git worktree at `7874dde` — the commit before the coverage rule — so
these are the **real** pre-R1 rule's numbers, not a reimplementation of it.

Valid only for the fixtures that produced them. Changing `turns.json` or `catalog.json`
invalidates this file until it is recaptured:

```
git worktree add /tmp/ratel-baseline 7874dde
cp src/core/tests/fixtures/{turns,catalog}.json /tmp/ratel-baseline/src/core/tests/fixtures/
# in the worktree: make IntentGraph::observe_live pub(crate), add
# ToolRegistry::with_embedder_for_test, register `#[cfg(test)] mod harness;` in lib.rs,
# and copy in src/core/src/harness.rs with the after-only parts removed (dense_verdict,
# Coverage, cohesion, the policy sweep, embed_query_batch_with_identity).
cargo test -p ratel-ai-core --lib harness_baseline -- --ignored --nocapture
```

Coverage, `covered`, cohesion and the policy sweep are absent by construction — they are
quantities only the post-R1 rule has. The comparable metrics are cluster shape, purity, merge
quality, and served top-k.

Generated by `cargo test -p ratel-ai-core --lib harness_baseline -- --ignored`.
Fixtures: `turns.json` (50 turns, 47 distinct queries), `catalog.json` (26 ops).

**Absolute numbers mean little — only deltas between runs on this fixture do.** One
embedding model, two domains, labels assigned by one person, and the same turns both
build and evaluate the graph, so this measures whether a change altered behaviour, not
whether it generalises.
